title: Unit Event — Farewell, My Mask — Episode3 My Crumbling Mask

meta.Event Outline: As if losing her computer wasn't bad enough, Mafuyu feels her mother's grip tighten on her life, taking an increasing toll on her mental state. Amid all this, her teacher is due to return the results of a final...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's been twenty minutes since lunch began... I guess Yuki isn't coming today either...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, someone just logged in. Is that...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Is everything okay?
You said you had to take a break from N25...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line:
<I can't stay long...
I'm just here to take a quick break.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, the rest of us should get to work! Our new song's actually almost finished!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I made this effect based on your lyrics, Yuki, and want to see what you think!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, me too.
Can you see if my rough sketch captures what you were going for with your lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Now that I'm hearing them together, these lyrics don't really work with this melody. Maybe I should go with something more straightforward...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, Enanan!
I need you to do a tiny favor for me!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're not talking about adding an extra section again, are you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I am! I've got a feeling that the part during the chorus is gonna look even better if we added a cut where she extends her hand out!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Extend her hand out...?
With the current composition, that means I'm gonna have to draw all of that in.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know but it'll make Yuki's lyrics hit just that much harder!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... Yeah, I get what you mean...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, K, you do?
Then, I'll give it a try...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Just hearing their voices helps put my mind at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You seem to be feeling a little better now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Interesting...
I think I'll need to adjust how to show it on screen a little.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Once Enanan's done making that hand asset we talked about, I'll try putting a cut together based on these lyrics!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<About that hand...
You know I pretty much have to draw it again from scratch, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Which is why you're the best!
Thanks for doing this, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, now that the lyrics are done, I should be able to finish all my touch-ups today if I really try. We could conceivably be finished by tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, if we record the vocals today and edit everything tomorrow, I'd say it'll be ready for upload by that evening.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, tomorrow's all about cleaning it up. I'm almost done too, so I'll try doing what I can again tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I don't know if I'll be here tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, right...
You still need to study.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, don't you want to finish what we've been working on together...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We'll let you know when we're about to upload it, so try to be there for that. I mean, it was a group effort...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Then, I'll see what I can do...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <And I'll let you all know if I can't make it.>

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming all this way.
So, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Still, I feel terrible about asking you to meet with me so suddenly. I know parent-teacher conferences don't take place for some time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But my daughter's been behaving so oddly at home lately. It's really quite worrisome...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which is why I was hoping to hear how she's been at school.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
It's normal for a parent to be concerned about their child, so I understand.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Normal as far as I can tell...
She's been fulfilling her responsibilities as a class representative as always, and is adored by all her peers. I couldn't ask for a better student.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Was there anything else? I would appreciate anything you could share with me, even if it's minor...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Actually...
She did make quite a few mistakes on her finals. It was strange to see...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To be fair, we all have our bad days, so I'm sure it's no cause for concern.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It's just... She hardly ever makes careless mistakes like that, so–

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Excuse me. What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You've already finished grading her finals?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, I handed them back the other day... I assumed she'd already told you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hello?
Yes, this is Mafuyu Asahina's mother.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I apologize for calling you so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right...
How has Mafuyu been acting lately?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. She's always working very hard, so I'll remind her that she needs to take breaks on occasion...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (She hid how she did on her finals from me and didn't show up for cram school...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (If this keeps up, she's going to lose focus and not do as well as she needs to on her entrance exams...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (Which means she won't get accepted to her top choice.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That is simply not an option...
